decisions.label: Least gap between sites (m)
decisions.note: The least gap, edge to edge, between any two sites: stumps' clearings, legends' circles, the challenge circle's ground, the find's clearing, and home's dancefloor and treehouse as one (Ed, 2026-11-04: "minimum distance between sites/circles/dancefloor/treehouse of 50m, tunable"; "The dancefloor and treehouse can be closer! they're a set piece"). Two stumps' middles are 84 m apart at 50. Lower lets stumps and circles crowd; higher moves more of them, and a small area may not hold one (logged). A new map: it reloads.

decisions.label: Least gap from a lake (m)
decisions.note: The least gap between any site's footprint (a stump's clearing, a legend's circle, the challenge circle's ground) and a lake's water (Ed, 2026-11-04: "10m from a lake edge"). A new map: it reloads.
